Worth a maintainer look if the file is ever repurposed for self-study.

The Absorption bullet ('the gap between generating and reading decides your real throughput', line 13) is the most abstract of the three governor definitions and, unlike Verification ('stops being a glance and becomes a job') and Outcome ('crosses the wall from you to the team'), carries no concrete grounding clause. Trace mood holds at 8/10 (floor is 8), but both trace generations name this specific bullet as the one that keeps the beat from a 9. Non-blocking; a one-clause concrete hook would close the gap.

The closing question ('what makes you trust the result at the end?', line 19) names no mode — answer aloud, jot a line, or hold silently are all consistent with the text as written. Persona trace flags this same ambiguity across both generations. Non-blocking in an in-room delivery (the trainer sets the mode live), but worth a one-clause steer if the file is ever read outside a trainer-led room.
